attempts.summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (RHEL9), using systemd units bound to each node's real IP (10.100.215.10/11/12) on ports 2379/2380, after opening those ports in firewalld (which was silently blocking peer traffic). Verified cross-member replication, verified reads/writes continue with one member down (quorum preserved) and that the member catches up on rejoin, then performed the mandatory sequential native reboot (shutdown -r now) of all three nodes one at a time, confirming changed boot_id and full cluster/data recovery after each.
